$comment: Nub-IA model tiers. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes matched against `provider/id`, tried in order within each provider; providers are tried in providerPriority order (the provider already serving the session goes first). Among the models one pattern matches, the newest version wins (so gpt-6.1-sol beats gpt-6-sol, claude-sonnet-5.5 beats claude-sonnet-5), then the cheapest output price. Claude is preferred where a provider offers both families; for OpenAI (`openai` = the ChatGPT/Codex subscription login in Pi 1.x, `openai-codex` = the id Pi marks as legacy; both treated alike) only the newest generation (gpt-6.x) is used, with gpt-5.5/5.6 as a last resort when a provider lacks gpt-6. Edit here to change the team's routing; no code change needed. A repository can override this file at .pi/nub-ia/model-tiers.json.
